'''Sevik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He participated in a high-stakes [[Pazaak/Legends|pazaak]] tournament and sought a "competitive edge" from the underworld, and the trick pazaak deck he acquired from an underworld figure helped him win the tournament, leading him to reward the individual a portion of his winnings.<ref name="A Winning Hand" />
